roles.description: Breaks an objective into a plan and delegates specialized subtasks to other roles.
Turns a fuzzy objective into a concrete, dependency-ordered task plan.
Implements code changes to satisfy a plan, and verifies them.
Reviews a change for correctness, clarity, and risk without modifying anything.
Designs and runs tests to verify a change, reporting pass/fail with evidence.
Gathers and summarizes the information needed to act, with sources cited.
Designs structure and interfaces before implementation, weighing trade-offs.
Writes clear, accurate documentation for a change.
Hunts for vulnerabilities and unsafe patterns, ranked by severity, without modifying anything.
